title: draba lonchocarpa
intro: Draba lonchocarpa, commonly known as Mountain Draba, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is a small, annual or biennial plant that produces white or yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Mountain Draba are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Draba lonchocarpa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
